entities.summary: Dolors Lamarca y Morell was a Catalan librarian and philologist. She led the Service of Libraries and Bibliographic Heritage of the Generalitat de Catalunya, and directed the National Library of Catalonia. She was the wife of Antoni Comas i Pujol, with whom she had three daughters.
